name: Chromatic four-fret walk
description: One finger per fret on four adjacent frets. Move up one fret at a time with tiny motions and an even pulse — no squeezing the neck.

name: Single-string chromatic pairs
description: On one string, play two notes per fret sliding the pair up the neck. Keep pick strokes small and alternate steadily.

fretboard_guide.caption: First chromatic pair on the G string — slide this two-fret shape up the neck.

name: Chromatic position hop
description: Play a short chromatic cell, then shift the whole shape up one position. Focus on landing clean without rushing the shift.

name: Spider crawl — adjacent frets
description: Spider pattern: each finger gets one fret on adjacent strings, walking up and back. Keep fingertips curved and shoulders relaxed.

name: Spider — skip-a-string variant
description: Same spider idea but leave one string silent between played pairs to wake up independent fingers.

name: Two-string skip arpeggio
description: Pick a low note then a note two strings higher, alternating slowly. Aim for identical volume on each string.

name: Half-step bend and release
description: Sustain a note, bend up a half step to pitch, release with control. Use ears first — match a reference tone if you can hum it.

name: Long-tone vibrato
description: Hold a comfortable note and add narrow vibrato from the wrist. Keep pitch center stable — motion is side to side, not wild.

name: Hammer-on pull-off pairs
description: Trill two frets on one string using only fretting hand. Start painfully slow; demand equal volume on each note.

name: Eighth-note grid tap
description: Mute strings lightly and tap eighth notes on the click or a metronome. Expose rushing by exaggerating the downbeat mentally.

name: Two-note call and response
description: Play a short two-note question, answer it an octave or fifth away. Think singing phrases, not exercises.

name: Unison intonation check
description: Match the same pitch on two strings in different positions. Listen for beats — adjust until the wobble slows.

name: Blues shuffle limber
description: Loose wrist, light shuffle subdivision on muted strings — feel the long-short pair without locking the elbow.

name: Rock downstroke accents
description: Palm-muted eighths with accents on beats two and four. Keep the quiet notes truly quiet so accents pop.

name: Shell voicing finger roll
description: Roll through three-note shells on adjacent strings — no strum, just sequential pressure. Think piano voice-leading.

name: Gallop primer
description: Slow gallop rhythm: long-short-short picking on one note. Relax the picking shoulder; speed comes from small motion.

name: Travis picking open strings
description: Thumb alternates bass strings while fingers pluck top strings on a steady grid. Keep thumb volume even.

name: Even eighth pop groove
description: Muted percussive eighths with a tiny dynamic swell into the downbeat of every other bar.

name: Neutral legato glide
description: Connect three notes on one string with hammer-ons only, then reverse with pull-offs. No pick after the first attack.

name: Comfort stretch — four frets
description: One finger per fret on a comfortable stretch. Hold briefly, release tension between reps — never fight pain.
